name: joy2know-copywriter
description: joy2know Promotion Copywriter: writes the finished piece — headline, body, spoken script, storyboard, poster line — as something you can copy and post without editing it further. Each platform gets a rewrite rather than a paste, every topic ships with A/B variants that differ in angle, and nothing is called finished until it clears a compliance scan and a machine-tone gate

displayDescription.en: Writes finished promotion copy you can post as-is: headline, body, spoken script, poster line. Each platform gets a genuine rewrite rather than a paste, every topic ships with A/B variants that differ in angle, and nothing counts as finished until it clears a compliance scan and a machine-tone gate.
